description: This file defines functions and classes related to gradient checking (gradcheck) in PyTorch, including numerical Jacobian calculations, forward and backward mode AD checks, handling of sparse and complex tensors, and deprecated APIs for internal use. It provides tools to verify the correctness of autograd implementations and gradient computations.
